name: Tailscale VPN
author: John Myers
description: Connects FPP to your Tailscale network so your own devices can reach it securely from anywhere. Sign-in and connections go through Tailscale's servers (controlplane.tailscale.com, and derp*.tailscale.com relays), and Tailscale is installed from its own apt source, pkgs.tailscale.com.

privacy.summary: Connects FPP to your Tailscale network so your own devices can reach it from anywhere. Tailscale (tailscale.com) runs the sign-in and connection service.

sends.what: this player's name, network addresses and encryption keys
sends.why: to sign this player in to your Tailscale network
so your devices can reach this player and its web pages
to reach your devices when a direct connection isn't possible

sends.what: requests to download the Tailscale package
sends.why: to install Tailscale, and to update it if you turn on automatic updates

collects.what: this player's Tailscale identity and keys

systemChanges.what: adds Tailscale's apt source (pkgs.tailscale.com) and signing key, pinned so it can only supply the tailscale package
runs tailscaled with log upload off. After you first click Connect, it starts at every boot and keeps running while FPP is stopped, until uninstalled
joins this player to your Tailscale network, so your Tailscale devices can reach it and FPP's web pages
adds a tailscale0 network interface, and uses networks your tailnet shares if you turn on subnet routes

privacy.other: Nothing connects to Tailscale until you click Connect or turn on auto-connect. Tailscale's diagnostic log upload is turned off, so Tailscale can't offer technical support for this player. If an FPP OS update removes Tailscale, auto-connect reinstalls it from pkgs.tailscale.com. Uninstalling logs this player out of Tailscale and removes the Tailscale package, its apt source, signing key and pin, unless Tailscale was installed before the plugin: then it stays installed, and the settings the plugin changed are put back as they were.
